lines.en: label beachmas13:
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene rpexercise1
: Loyal followers who have graciously heeded my call! Surrender to me your time, and I will give unto you abilities unlike anyone has ever seen!
lines.zh: : 忠诚的信徒们，感谢你们慷慨地响应我的召唤！把你们的时间交给我，我将赐予你们前所未见的能力！

lines.en: : To unite all peoples within our nation!
lines.zh: : 为了统一我们国家的所有民族！

lines.en: : Nice try, Ram! But this is not a two part speech and we have already exhausted our usage of the Team Rocket motto!
lines.zh: : 想得美，Ram！但这不是两段式演讲，而且火箭队口号的额度我们已经用完了！

lines.en: : Molly, what are we doing?
lines.zh: : Molly，我们在干什么？

lines.en: scene rpexercise2
: An excellent question, Urrheak. And one that will be met with an excellent answer once I set the table. Just...in a metaphorical sense as our next real session isn’t until next weekend.
lines.zh: : 好问题，Urrheak。等我布置好桌面，你就会得到一个同样出色的答案。只是……是隐喻意义上的布置，因为我们真正的下一次跑团要到下周末。

lines.en: : If this has something to do with D&D, why is Yasu here? And where are the rest of the regular members? Why am I the only one who had to come?
lines.zh: : 如果这事跟龙与地下城有关，那 Yasu 为什么在这儿？其他固定成员又在哪儿？为什么只有我非来不可？

lines.en: scene rpexercise3
: As your dungeon master and someone who puts extraordinary thought into each and every one of your questions, I am going to need you to limit yourself to one at a time.
lines.zh: : 作为你们的地下城主，也作为一个对你们每一个问题都极其上心的人，我需要你一次只问一个。

lines.en: : Please select an option from the screen you see before you. They should all be popping up in the form of a menu right now.
lines.zh: : 请从你们面前的屏幕上选择一个选项。它们现在应该都以菜单的形式弹出来了。

lines.en: : Your decision may directly influence whether or not we kiss in the future.
lines.zh: : 你的选择可能会直接影响我们将来会不会接吻。

lines.en: scene rpexercise4
: Your time has expired. Molly will remember this.
lines.zh: : 你的时间到了。Molly 会记住这一点的。

lines.en: : What are we doing?
lines.zh: : 我们在干什么？

lines.en: : A roleplaying exercise.
lines.zh: : 一场角色扮演练习。

lines.en: : And I’m the only one from the normal group here because?...
lines.zh: : 那常规成员里只有我一个人在这儿，是因为？……

lines.en: : Because you’re the worst at roleplaying.
lines.zh: : 因为你角色扮演最烂。

lines.en: scene rpexercise5
: What?! Since when?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！从什么时候开始的？！

lines.en: : Umm...since the beginning?
lines.zh: : 嗯……从一开始？

lines.en: : Technically speaking, Ram is most certainly worse than you. But I am already having her serve as my assistant in this exercise, so she is unable to appear as a player as well.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，Ram 肯定比你更烂。但这次练习我已经让她来当我的助手了，所以她没法同时以玩家身份出场。

lines.en: : There is no way Ami is better than me at roleplaying.
lines.zh: : Ami 不可能比我更擅长角色扮演。

lines.en: scene rpexercise6
: I actually believe that Ami is rather exceptional and that all of the flaws in Arborea’s character are simply a byproduct of the type of girl she is in-world.
lines.zh: : 我其实觉得 Ami 相当出色，而 Arborea 这个角色身上的所有缺陷，不过是她在游戏世界里那类女孩的副产品。

lines.en: : Plus, she's much more involved in the actual happenings of the campaign than Urrheak. So I believe it would be best if you would, for lack of a better term, {i}git gud.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而且她比 Urrheak 更深入地参与了战役中实际发生的事。所以我觉得，恕我找不到更好的说法——你还是{i}练练技术{/i}吧。

lines.en: : You realize Yasu’s not even part of the campaign, right? How am I supposed to {i}git gud{/i} by practicing with someone who has not only less experience than me, but is {i}clinically insane?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你知道 Yasu 根本就不在这个战役里吧？我要跟一个不但经验比我少、而且{i}临床意义上疯了{/i}的人练习，要怎么{i}练技术{/i}？

lines.en: : If the light of the Lord makes me crazy, I don’t want to be sane.
lines.zh: : 如果主的光会让我发疯，那我不要清醒。

lines.en: : Do you see what I mean?
lines.zh: : 你明白我的意思了吧？

lines.en: scene rpexercise7
: Hey! Yasu’s a valued member of the manga club now. Which means that it’s only fair that she gets invited to all of the same nerdy things that we do or she will feel like an outcast.
lines.zh: : 嘿！Yasu 现在是漫画社的重要成员了。这意味着我们有义务邀请她参加所有我们参加的宅活动，不然她会觉得自己被排挤了。

lines.en: : I am not meant to blend in with anyone. A streak of white stands out amidst a sea of darkness. And if there is anything-
lines.zh: : 我本就不该融入任何人。一抹白色在黑暗的海洋中格外醒目。而如果有任何——

lines.en: : Yes, god is good. Hooray. Now what?
lines.zh: : 是是是，神是好的。万岁。然后呢？

lines.en: : Roll for initiative. Ram does not like the attitude the bird person is taking and has an advantage on attacks against all feathered creatures.
lines.zh: : 掷先攻。Ram 不喜欢那个鸟人现在的态度，她对所有带羽毛的生物都有攻击优势。

lines.en: : Nobody is rolling for initiative. This is a combat-free zone right now and any attempt at violence will be immediately thwarted by a large group of men in robes watching from the corners of the room.
lines.zh: : 谁都不用掷先攻。现在这里是非战斗区，任何暴力企图都会被角落里那一大群穿长袍的男人立刻制止。

lines.en: : I like this game.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢这个游戏。

lines.en: : We haven’t technically started yet, Yasu.
lines.zh: : Yasu，严格来说我们还没开始呢。

lines.en: scene rpexercise8
: How will I know when we’ve begun? Will it hurt? Because Touka will be very upset if I get injured while she is not around.
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道我们什么时候开始了？会痛吗？因为如果我不在她身边的时候受了伤，Touka 会非常难过的。

lines.en: : Are you seriously making me do this?
lines.zh: : 你真的要逼我做这个？

lines.en: : I’ll reward you with a new magic item at the end of the session if I believe you’ve done well. You’re the only member of the party without one right now, so it’s sure to come in handy.
lines.zh: : 如果你表现得好，这轮结束时我会奖励你一件新的魔法物品。你现在是队伍里唯一一个没有魔法物品的人，所以它肯定派得上用场。

lines.en: : Or not. I don’t know. I haven’t thought up an item yet.
lines.zh: : 也可能派不上。我也不知道。我还没想好是什么物品呢。

lines.en: : I hope you’ve put more effort into the scenario than you have the reward.
lines.zh: : 希望你在这个剧本上花的精力比在奖励上多。

lines.en: scene rpexercise9
: Never fear, Aarakocra! For I have devised an in-universe, solo-scenario for everyone’s favorite unenthusiastic bird-cleric!
lines.zh: : 别怕，Aarakocra！因为我为大家最爱的那个毫无热情的鸟人牧师，量身设计了一个世界观内的单人剧本！

lines.en: : Oh, you’re far too kind.
lines.zh: : 哦，您太客气了。

lines.en: : Birds are sacred beings in the eyes of He who is so commonly misunderstood. They can pass through planes at will and hear things that normal humans can not.
lines.zh: : 在那位常被误解的祂眼中，鸟类是神圣的存在。它们可以随意穿行于各个位面，听到普通人类听不见的东西。

lines.en: : This particular bird wishes she were deaf right about now.
lines.zh: : 这只特别的鸟现在真希望自己是个聋子。

lines.en: : Ram makes a ranged attack against Urrheak.
lines.zh: : Ram 对 Urrheak 发动远程攻击。

lines.en: : Ram doesn’t have a bow. It was confiscated at the door.
lines.zh: : Ram 没有弓。在门口被没收了。

lines.en: : Ram casts fireball.
lines.zh: : Ram 施放火球术。

lines.en: : Ram doesn’t have that spell. Now stop trying to fight and let me explain the scenario.
lines.zh: : Ram 不会那个法术。别再想着打架了，让我把剧本讲完。

lines.en: scene rpexercise10
: The church doors squeak and squeal as Urrheak pushes them open, setting foot into the main hall of the holiest building in all of Newhaven — the Cathedral of Misguided Souls.
lines.zh: : 教堂的门吱呀作响，Urrheak 推开门，踏进了整个 Newhaven 最神圣的建筑——迷途灵魂大教堂——的正厅。

lines.en: : The rest of the party has split off...venturing into separate parts of the town in order to train and hone their respective skills before their next major outing.
lines.zh: : 队伍的其他人已经分头行动……前往城镇的不同区域，在下次重大行动之前磨练各自的技能。

lines.en: : It’s the middle of the day...and yet no one apart from several nuns and men dressed in robes is present in the entire hall.
lines.zh: : 正值正午……可整个大厅里除了几名修女和几个穿长袍的男人，一个人都没有。

lines.en: : Urrheak, who has fallen out of favor with his god due to the unending, gluttonous indulgence in food and drink, seeks to regain favor...or perhaps even find a {i}new{/i} god.
lines.zh: : Urrheak 因为无止境地暴饮暴食而失宠于他的神，如今他想要重获眷顾……或者干脆找一位{i}新{/i}的神。

lines.en: : But is this cathedral the right destination for a goal like this?...Or is there something sinister lurking in the background...waiting for a chance to prey upon him in his weakest moment?
lines.zh: : 可这座大教堂真是实现这种目标的正确去处吗？……还是说，暗处正潜伏着某种邪恶……等着在他最虚弱的时刻下手？

lines.en: scene rpexercise11

: A hoodless nun, Deirbhile, who looks starkly different from the rest, steps into a circle created by rays of light leaking in through stained glass...looks Urrheak right in the eyes...and says {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 一位没有戴头巾、与其他人截然不同的修女 Deirbhile，踏进了彩色玻璃透进来的光线所围成的圆圈……直视着 Urrheak 的眼睛……然后说了{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : It is at this point, Yasu, where you will take the role of your character and-
lines.zh: : Yasu，就在这里，你要开始扮演你的角色，然后——

lines.en: scene rpexercise12
: Is it salvation you seek, feathered one?...Or are you lost in more ways than one?
lines.zh: : 羽翼者啊，你所寻求的是救赎吗？……还是说，你迷失的不止一个方向？

lines.en: : Oooh! Okay! No trouble at all, I see! Very impressive!
lines.zh: : 哦哦！好的！看来完全没问题嘛！非常令人印象深刻！

lines.en: : There is no need to fear me...for all people are safe within these walls. And the only enemy you will ever encounter within them is your own reflection.
lines.zh: : 不必惧怕我……因为在这堵墙内，所有人都安全。你在这里唯一会遇到的敌人，是你自己的倒影。

lines.en: : So, tell me...what is it that brings you here? What is it that brings you to the closest idea of {i}Heaven{/i} that we could ever truly know?
lines.zh: : 那么，告诉我……是什么把你带到这里来？是什么把你带到我们真正能认知的{i}天堂{/i}最近的地方？

lines.en: : The nun steps out of the light and comes face to face with Urrheak! But despite being a full two feet shorter, it is {i}she{/i} who seems more powerful at the moment.
lines.zh: : 修女走出光圈，与 Urrheak 正面相对！尽管整整矮了两英尺，此刻看起来更有压迫感的却是{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: scene rpexercise13
: Hah...
: I come not in search of salvation...but guidance. As it appears I have lost my way.
lines.zh: : 我来并非寻求救赎……而是寻求指引。因为看来我迷路了。

lines.en: : We all lose our way from time to time, feathered one. With paths so shrouded by darkness, it only makes sense that you’ll forget where you are going if you look away for even a moment.
lines.zh: : 羽翼者啊，我们都会有迷路的时候。道路被黑暗遮蔽得如此严实，哪怕只是移开视线一瞬，你也会忘了自己要去哪儿，这再自然不过。

lines.en: : But before I tell you how to find your way home...may I ask...what do you hope to find when you get there?
lines.zh: : 但在我告诉你如何找到回家的路之前……我能问问吗……你到了那里，希望找到什么？

lines.en: : Food.
lines.zh: : 食物。

lines.en: : Isn’t that precisely what landed you here in the first place?
lines.zh: : 这不正是当初把你弄到这儿来的原因吗？

lines.en: scene rpexercise14
: Isn’t that meta-gaming? She’s not supposed to know that. She just remembers it from your description earlier.
lines.zh: : 这不算元游戏吗？她不该知道那件事。她只是从你前面的描述里记住了而已。

lines.en: : Yasu’s character is an extremely powerful arch-priest with the ability to successfully cast Detect Thoughts on any humanoid creature without giving them a chance to block it via Wisdom save.
lines.zh: : Yasu 的角色是一位极为强大的大祭司，能够成功对任何人形生物施放"侦测思想"，而且对方没有靠感知豁免来抵抗的机会。

lines.en: : Basically, she reads minds and there is nothing you can do about it.
lines.zh: : 简单来说，她会读心，而你拿它一点办法都没有。

lines.en: : Oh, good. That’s fair.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。那就合理了。

lines.en: scene rpexercise15
: Yes. That is the reason I am here. But frankly, I find it exhausting having to obey the words and laws of a god when there are things out there more important to me.
lines.zh: : 是的。那就是我来这儿的原因。但坦白说，既然世上还有对我更重要的东西，要我去遵守一位神的言语和律法，实在让我疲惫。

lines.en: : There is nothing more important than God.
lines.zh: : 没有什么比神更重要。

lines.en: : There are {i}tons{/i} of things more important than god. Food, friends, fun...why should an invisible entity be the one who chooses the paths we walk when we’re perfectly capable of choosing ourselves?
lines.zh: : 比神重要的东西{i}多了去了{/i}。食物、朋友、快乐……我们明明有能力自己选择，凭什么要一个看不见的存在来决定我们走的路？

lines.en: : If that were the case, you wouldn’t be here.
lines.zh: : 如果真是那样，你就不会在这儿了。

lines.en: : The only reason you have entered these halls is because you did not know where to go...and felt powerless without the guidance you abhor so much.
lines.zh: : 你走进这些大厅的唯一理由，就是你不知道该去哪儿……没有你如此厌恶的指引，你就感到无能为力。

lines.en: : Do you not see the hypocrisy?
lines.zh: : 你看不出这有多虚伪吗？

lines.en: : All I see is another cultist trying to fortify the numbers of her organization through vague projection and what I assume is a gross amount of donations from the local aristocracy.
lines.zh: : 我只看到又一个邪教信徒，靠着含糊其辞的投射，还有我猜是当地贵族的大量捐款，来壮大她那个组织的规模。

lines.en: scene rpexercise16
: At that moment, the candles blow out — leaving the light Deirbhile was standing in moments ago as the only thing illuminating the hall.
lines.zh: : 就在那一刻，蜡烛全被吹灭——只剩 Deirbhile 片刻前站在其中的那束光，成了大厅里唯一的光源。

lines.en: : It is clear by the reaction from the hooded men and other nuns that this is no normal feat. Chatter can be heard in the background as some of the men and women begin to filter into smaller, private rooms.
lines.zh: : 从那些戴兜帽的男人和其他修女的反应来看，这显然不是寻常之事。背景里能听到嘈杂的交谈声，一些男女开始往更小的私室里散去。

lines.en: : Urrheak can feel something churning in his chest...like it’s reacting to the dark. And it compels him to move closer to the light to quell it.
lines.zh: : Urrheak 能感觉到有什么在他胸腔里翻涌……像是在对黑暗起反应。而它迫使他靠近那束光，好平息下来。

lines.en: scene rpexercise17
: Urrheak...does {i}not{/i} move closer to the light. In fact, he takes a step further away from it.
lines.zh: : Urrheak……{i}没有{/i}靠近那束光。事实上，他又往后退了一步。

lines.en: : The churning in his stomach grows more violent in response.
lines.zh: : 作为回应，他胃里的翻涌变得更加剧烈。

lines.en: : The word “cultist” is so harsh...don’t you think?
lines.zh: : "邪教信徒"这个词太刺耳了……你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : It matters not to me what the others think or do...as they’ll all wind up in these halls once the rest of the roads have been plucked from the ground and consumed.
lines.zh: : 别人怎么想、怎么做，我都不在意……因为等其余的道路都被从地面上拔起、吞噬之后，他们最终都会走进这些大厅。

lines.en: : It is just my greatest pleasure to help those in need find their way sooner.
lines.zh: : 我只是最大的乐趣，就是帮那些有需要的人更早找到路。

lines.en: : And if there was ever {i}anyone{/i} who looked like they could benefit from my assistance...it would be you.
lines.zh: : 而如果说有{i}谁{/i}看起来最需要我的帮助……那就是你了。

lines.en: scene rpexercise18
: Uh-huh. And what makes me different from the rest? What is so special about {i}me{/i} compared to those I travel with?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那我和其他人有什么不同？比起和我同行的那些人，{i}我{/i}有什么特别的？

lines.en: : All you need to do is look in the mirror and you will know.
lines.zh: : 你只要照照镜子就知道了。

lines.en: : No mirrors around. Just tell me, Deir...whatever.
lines.zh: : 这儿没有镜子。直接告诉我吧，Deir……什么来着。

lines.en: : If you would like the simple answer...
lines.zh: : 如果你想要个简单的答案……

lines.en: : It’s your feathers.
lines.zh: : 是你的羽毛。

lines.en: : Your ability to take flight...venture forth to places unseen by the rest of us. Places that could never be reached without {i}your{/i} help...or...
lines.zh: : 是你飞翔的能力……能飞向我们其他人看不见的地方。没有{i}你{/i}的帮助就永远到不了的地方……或者……

lines.en: : At least someone {i}like{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 至少是{i}像{/i}你这样的人。

lines.en: : There aren’t many...but they exist. And even those dwindling, finite numbers shake you to your core...don’t they?
lines.zh: : 数量不多……但确实存在。而即便是那些日渐稀少、屈指可数的同类，也足以让你从骨子里战栗……不是吗？

lines.en: : The reason you ask what makes you special is not because you disbelieve it...but because you want to be reassured. You want to know you’re {i}different.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你问自己有什么特别，并不是因为你不相信……而是因为你想被肯定。你想知道自己是{i}与众不同{/i}的。

lines.en: : But that difference will expire just as all things will. And the only way to postpone your demise is to-
lines.zh: : 可那份与众不同终将像万物一样消亡。而唯一能推迟你覆灭的方法，就是——

lines.en: scene rpexercise19
: Okay, can we stop here? Urrheak wouldn’t have even come somewhere like this in the first place if he was so disinterested in his god that he started acting out against him.
lines.zh: : 好了，能停在这儿吗？Urrheak 如果对他的神冷漠到开始反抗的地步，他一开始根本就不会来这种地方。

lines.en: : And yet you did.
lines.zh: : 可你还是来了。

lines.en: : Yeah, because I didn’t have a choice in the matter.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为这件事我别无选择。

lines.en: : That’s exactly what I’ve been saying all along...{i}Urrheak.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这正是我从头到尾在说的事啊……{i}Urrheak{/i}。

lines.en: scene rpexercise20
: Yasu, you know that gods are just things we came up with to make ourselves worry less about dying, right? Things we, human beings, invented to fill some sort of void in ourselves.
lines.zh: : Yasu，你知道神不过是我们为了让自己少害怕一点死亡而编出来的东西吧？是我们人类发明出来填补自身某种空洞的东西。

lines.en: : Hey, Ur- Maya. There’s no need to make things all personal. Yasu was just playing a character.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Ur——Maya。没必要把事情搞得这么私人。Yasu 只是在扮演一个角色而已。

lines.en: scene rpexercise21
: Character?
lines.zh: : 角色？

lines.en: : Yeah, and that’s good for her. But forcing characters that don’t mix together doesn’t always lead to a good result when opposites only attract like...10%% of the time max.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这对她来说是好事。可把合不来的角色硬凑在一起，结果未必好——毕竟"相异相吸"最多也就……10%% 的时候成立吧。

lines.en: : This wasn’t a roleplaying exercise. It was a {i}disagreement{/i} exercise that mimicked nearly a million conversations I’ve had about this exact thing in the past. It’s just annoying.
lines.zh: : 这根本不是角色扮演练习。这是一场"{i}分歧练习{/i}"，几乎复刻了我过去就这件事进行过的上百万次对话。只会让人烦躁。

lines.en: scene rpexercise22
: Why do you always say things that make you feel so alone?
lines.zh: : 你为什么总要说那些让自己显得那么孤独的话？

lines.en: : And that! How do you {i}do{/i} that?! How do you just start crying out of nowhere all the time?!
lines.zh: : 还有那个！你是怎么{i}做到{/i}的？！你怎么能总是无缘无故就哭起来？！

lines.en: : I believe Yasu has what are called “feelings.” Which is something you appear to not understand as you are currently desecrating a holy site with universe-breaking dialogue.
lines.zh: : 我想 Yasu 拥有的东西叫做"感情"。这似乎是你所不理解的——毕竟你现在正用崩坏世界观的台词亵渎一处圣地。

lines.en: : That’s true. I never called an end to the session, so this is all still canonically happening in the campaign. Kind of. I don’t know. I might have to write around it later. We’ll see.
lines.zh: : 确实。我从没宣布本轮结束，所以这一切在战役里仍然算是正式发生的。大概吧。我也不知道。我可能以后得想办法圆过去。到时候再看。

lines.en: : Nothing I do is universe-breaking. But forcing characters into situations they don’t belong in is-
lines.zh: : 我做的任何事都不会崩坏世界观。可把角色硬塞进不属于他们的处境里就是——

lines.en: : Is something a...god would do?...
lines.zh: : 是……神才会做的事？……

lines.en: scene rpexercise23
: He is real...
lines.zh: : 祂是真的存在的……

lines.en: : And He wants {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而祂想要{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: scene rpexercise24
: My ability to differentiate good roleplaying from bad roleplaying is obviously not substantial seeing as I am a part of the exercise, but Yasu’s character seemed very believable.
lines.zh: : 既然我自己也参与在这场练习里，我辨别角色扮演好坏的能力显然不太够用，但 Yasu 的角色看起来非常可信。

lines.en: : Character?
lines.zh: : 角色？

lines.en: : I agree. I’m not sure how I feel about adding another party member at this stage in the game as Rin has yet to return, but perhaps Yasu would be interested in playing several NPCs for fun?
lines.zh: : 我同意。在 Rin 还没回来的这个阶段再加一名队员，我不太确定自己怎么想，不过也许 Yasu 会有兴趣顺便扮演几个 NPC 玩玩？

lines.en: : Has Nithhala announced an interest in returning?
lines.zh: : Nithhala 有表示过想回来吗？

lines.en: : Nithhala and I don’t talk very much anymore. But I have a feeling she’ll be back one day. No one stays a normie forever.
lines.zh: : 我和 Nithhala 已经不怎么联系了。但我有种感觉，她总有一天会回来的。没人会永远当个普通人。

lines.en: : EVERYBODY SHUT UP!
lines.zh: : 所有人都给我闭嘴！

lines.en: : Oh, speaking of normies.
lines.zh: : 哦，说到普通人。

lines.en: scene rpexercise25
: Playtime is over! The queen is going to be on TV in five minutes and everybody needs to shut the fuck up so we can all worship her!
lines.zh: : 游戏时间结束了！女王五分钟后就要上电视了，所有人都给我他妈闭嘴，好让咱们一起膜拜她！

lines.en: scene rpexercise27
: Alas...our fun has once again been cut down by the popular folk and their ability to control the room.
lines.zh: : 唉……我们的乐趣又一次被那些受欢迎的家伙、以及他们掌控全场的能力给斩断了。

lines.en: : I thought the queen died?
lines.zh: : 我记得女王不是死了吗？

lines.en: : Is {i}that{/i} why my dad sounded so happy on the phone the other day?
lines.zh: : {i}所以{/i}前几天我爸在电话里听起来才那么开心吗？

lines.en: scene rpexercise26
: Hey. How’d the roleplaying exercise go? I wanted to come and watch, but I buried Sana too deep in the sand and it took forever to get her out.
lines.zh: : 嘿。角色扮演练习怎么样？我本来想来看的，但我把 Sana 埋进沙子里埋得太深，花了好久才把她挖出来。

lines.en: : I thought...I was going to die...
lines.zh: : 我以为……我要死了……

lines.en: : It...went. That’s for sure.
lines.zh: : 它……进行了。这点可以肯定。

lines.en: : Oh, and have you seen Ami anywhere? She’s been gone for a while and I haven’t been able to reach her.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，你有没有在哪儿见过 Ami？她已经走开好一阵子了，我一直联系不上她。

lines.en: : Not since this morning. But unless her interests have completely changed overnight, I’m sure she’ll be back to watch the {i}queen{/i} momentarily.
lines.zh: : 从今天早上起就没见过。不过除非她的兴趣一夜之间彻底变了，我敢肯定她一会儿就会回来看{i}女王{/i}的。

lines.en: scene rpexercise28
: The queen? Didn’t she die?
lines.zh: : 女王？她不是死了吗？

lines.en: : Not that queen — Niki Nakayama. Kumon-mi’s idol queen.
lines.zh: : 不是那个女王——是 Niki Nakayama。Kumon-mi 的偶像女王。

lines.en: : Oh, her? I’ve seen her on billboards. I just call her Hot Noriko.
lines.zh: : 哦，她啊？我在广告牌上见过她。我管她叫"辣妹 Noriko"。

lines.en: scene rpexercise29
: Hi. Ugly Niki here. Who are we making fun of next?
lines.zh: : 嗨。丑女 Niki 驾到。接下来我们要笑话谁？

lines.en: : Go grab your Halloween costume if you wanna compete again, kid. It’s all been downhill for you since then.
lines.zh: : 想再来比一次就去把你的万圣节戏服拿来，小鬼。从那之后你就一路走下坡了。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m at my prettiest when it looks like I’m capable of killing people. And I left my pocket knife at home on accident, so I’m just screwed all weekend, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 是啊。我看起来能杀人的时候最漂亮。而我又不小心把折叠刀落在家里了，所以这个周末我是彻底完蛋了，对吧？

lines.en: scene black
: Hey. Is your hot sister on TV yet? What’s she wearing? Rate the likelihood of a wardrobe malfunction on a scale of 1-10.
lines.zh: : 嘿。你那个辣妹姐姐上电视了吗？她穿的什么？用 1 到 10 打个分，说说走光的可能性有多大。

lines.en: : Why don’t we just...leave the door open so people can stop coming in like that?
lines.zh: : 要不我们就……把门开着吧，这样大家就不用这样闯进来了。
